# `discarded-must-use`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: correctness · Profile: none · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports `_ = call()` when the callable has a declared must-use contract.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Some successful return values carry work, ownership, or a final state that Zig
otherwise permits callers to discard.

## When it fires

Only explicit discard assignments to configured callables are reported.
